utterances.text: Hello there! How was your day?
Hi Grandpa! My day was pretty good, just busy with schoolwork.
Well, a little fresh air will do you good. Ready to learn how to cast that line?
Yeah, I'm ready! It's better than staring at my assignments and this Pop It Troll all day.
A Pop It Troll? I'm not sure what that is, but it sounds interesting!
Oh, it's just a toy that's really popular right now. It's like a fidget toy that you can pop back and forth.
Ah, I see! Well, put the toy aside for a moment. You need both hands to tighten the reel.
Got it. I'll tighten it up now. Is this enough tension on the line?
I'm not sure what you mean by 'tighten it up'—do you mean the drag setting?
Oh, I just meant making sure everything is in order. You know, make it 'slay'?
Slay? I think I left the bait in the shed. Let me go check while you practice your stance.
Okay, Grandpa! I'll wait here. Look what I found in the tackle box while you were gone!
That's great! What did you find?
I found some old photos tucked in the side pocket. They're really cool!
Sure, let's see. But first, show me a cast. Let's see how far you can go.
Alright, watch this! I'm going to aim for that lily pad.
Wow, that was impressive! You really threw it far for your first try.
Thanks! Now look at these photos. They're like a time capsule from when you were my age!
Do you remember any stories from when these were taken?
Ah, that's a good spot in the photo. That was my first big catch! You have the same look in your eyes today.
